backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (User, Store, OrderRecord, DistributorDelivery) and their in-memory maps, plus mixins for authorization and blob storage. Implements user management, order tracking, store management, and distributor delivery logic for the Vitalist Water app.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels. Covers blank page fixes, error boundary addition, and lazy-load Suspense boundary audits.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each file's purpose and notable bug fixes applied. Serves as a human-readable changelog/index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'Vitalist Water — Order & Delivery Management', linking the favicon, and mounting the React root via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ErrorBoundary, QueryClientProvider, and AuthProvider, implements role-based page routing with lazy-loaded pages and Suspense, and handles unauthenticated, loading, and authenticated states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable dashboard stat card component displaying a label, numeric count, icon, and optional trend text with configurable color themes.
frontend/src/components/delivery/EmptyTr: A dialog component that allows users to select and upload an empty truck image for a given order, showing a preview, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/delivery/ImageMo: A dialog component that displays a full-size image with zoom toggle functionality, or a placeholder if no image URL is provided.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Barc: A QR/barcode scanning step component that auto-starts the camera, displays a live video feed with a targeting overlay, and returns the scanned barcode value via callback.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Dist: A multi-step dialog (barcode scan → image upload → confirm → done) that collects delivery confirmation data and submits it via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Imag: A form step component for uploading two truck images (loaded and unloaded), with file previews and a submit handler that converts files to Uint8Array before calling the completion callback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches unhandled render errors and displays a branded fallback UI with the app name, error message, and a reload button.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppSideba: A role-based sidebar navigation component that renders different nav items for admin, staff, delivery, and distributor roles, along with user info and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main app layout component that renders a responsive sidebar, top header bar with user info and logout, and a main content area with a toast notifier.
frontend/src/components/map/SatelliteMap: Renders a Leaflet-based satellite map (Esri World Imagery tiles) with optional markers, labels, and click handlers, loading Leaflet dynamically from a CDN.
frontend/src/components/orders/InvoiceMo: Dialog modal that fetches order and store data, then renders an InvoiceView for a given order ID, showing skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/components/orders/InvoiceVi: Printable invoice document component displaying order details, store billing info, line items, totals, and an optional QR code, with a print/download button.
frontend/src/components/orders/QRPrintVi: Full-page print preview component that displays a QR code image (via qrserver.com API) and order ID, with print and close action buttons.
frontend/src/components/orders/StatusBad: Small badge component that displays an order status with a color and icon derived from utility helpers, supporting two size variants.
frontend/src/components/orders/WorkflowS: Visual progress indicator for order workflow stages, supporting a full step-by-step view with a connecting progress line or a compact dot/bar variant.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRCodeDisplay: Displays a QR code image fetched from an external URL for a given order ID, falling back to showing the raw ID text if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRScanModal.t: A modal dialog component that activates the device camera to scan QR codes, displaying loading/error states and invoking a callback with the scanned value on success.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides authentication context with login/logout functionality backed by a backend actor, persisting session data in sessionStorage and exposing role-based boolean flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor, using the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and exposing login/clear functions via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for all backend data operations including orders, stores, users, and deliveries, with role mapping helpers and actor-based mutation/query functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind CSS layers, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (colors, sidebar, status badges), and reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DeliveryVerific: Admin page that lists delivery verification records with truck images (inline thumbnails and modal zoom) and GPS map integration via dynamically loaded Leaflet.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DistributorDeli: Admin page for managing distributor deliveries with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog for creating/editing deliveries (truck number, driver info, estimated time) and a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/LiveTrackingPag: Admin page that displays real-time delivery tracking on a Leaflet map, polling the backend every 30 seconds and rendering truck markers for orders with 'Out for Delivery' or 'Dispatched' status.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing and managing orders with status filtering, status transition actions (approve/reject/advance), and a QR code print view for individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/QRManagementPag: Admin page that lists all orders with generated QR codes, showing stats for total, active, and completed QRs, with a search filter and a grid display of QR code cards.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: Admin analytics page that computes and displays order statistics (today/week/month counts, delivery totals, top stores, status breakdowns) using bar chart visualizations built from order and store data.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StoreManagement: Admin page for managing stores with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog with satellite map integration for selecting store coordinates and a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Admin page for managing users with add, edit, and delete functionality, supporting role assignment (admin, staff, delivery, distributor) via a dialog form and role-badged table display.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard page showing order statistics (admin) and a recent orders table with status badges, using React Query hooks to fetch data.
frontend/src/pages/delivery/DeliveryDash: Dashboard for delivery personnel showing dispatched and out-for-delivery orders, supporting QR code scanning to update order status and GPS location recording, with a post-delivery empty truck image upload prompt.
frontend/src/pages/distributor/Distribut: Dashboard for distributors listing their assigned deliveries with order and store details, allowing them to mark arrivals via a workflow dialog and showing delivery status badges.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login form page with email/password inputs, show/hide password toggle, and error handling that calls the AuthContext login function.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: QR scan workflow page supporting three role-based stages (admin, staff, delivery) that update order status and optionally capture GPS coordinates on scan.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page displaying the current user's account info and system metadata, with a sign-out button that calls the AuthContext logout function.
frontend/src/pages/staff/OrderCreationPa: Staff page for creating new orders by selecting a store, quantity, and rate, and displaying approved/ready orders with QR scan support for status updates.
frontend/src/utils/geoUtils.ts: Utility module providing geolocation helpers including Haversine distance calculation, distance formatting, browser geolocation retrieval, and Google Maps URL generation.
frontend/src/utils/imageUtils.ts: Utility module for image data conversion between Uint8Array, base64 data URLs, File objects, and raw base64 strings.
frontend/src/utils/orderUtils.ts: Defines order workflow stages, status helpers, QR encode/decode utilities, order ID/invoice generation, and metadata parsing/building functions for embedding structured data in order notes.
frontend/src/utils/qrGenerator.ts: Provides utility functions to generate QR code image URLs using the qrserver.com API, encoding order IDs as base64-prefixed strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to clean sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color palettes (including ocean, aqua, sidebar, and chart tokens), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and feature requests for a fix targeting a blank-page crash after deployment, listing three existing fix features covering error boundaries, null guards, and lazy-load Suspense wrapping.
